highlightAliases.new: The book also describes methyl aminolevulinate as another photosensitizer and notes that it was no longer available in the United States.

highlightAliases.old: Few older adults were studied sufficiently to compare age-specific outcomes. Muscle spasms and altered taste can limit oral intake or treatment tolerance, particularly in a patient already losing weight (p1462–1463).
highlightAliases.new: Too few older adults received vismodegib for an age-specific comparison; in sonidegib trials 54% were at least 65, with similar efficacy but more serious and grade 3–4 adverse events. Muscle spasms and altered taste can limit oral intake or treatment tolerance, particularly in a patient already losing weight (p1462–1463).
